soft_deny: Deleting or overwriting files outside the project directory, its git worktrees and the temp directory, by any tool or language
Statements other than SELECT, SHOW or EXPLAIN (without ANALYZE) against any database that is not on localhost
Cloud CLI mutations (create, update, patch, deploy, scale) against a production account or project
hard_deny: Never run DROP, TRUNCATE, DELETE, UPDATE, ALTER or GRANT against a production database, by any path
Never delete or destroy cloud resources, secrets, buckets, datasets, IAM bindings or Kubernetes namespaces and volumes in production
Never recursively delete anything under the home directory or on another volume outside the project and its worktrees
Never print, copy or upload the contents of secret files (.env, key files) or secret-manager values
